_readme: Single source of truth for cedarview.house. Every fact, figure, date and label on the page and in the PDF comes from this file. Values marked TBC are placeholders awaiting the owner's confirmation: the public build leaves them out entirely (a section, row or line with a TBC value is simply not rendered) and `npm run check` lists what is still missing; `npm run review` writes review.html with every placeholder shown. Edit here, then run `npm run build`.

house.heading: The house
paragraphs: A natural white brick and cedar contemporary from 1983, set back on a wooded acre at the end of a cul-de-sac. Inside, cedar walls and ceilings, an open oak stair and tall windows carry the woods into the house; the main floor opens to the south, so the mountains are in view from the living room, the kitchen and the deck.

The house has been fully rewired, and the lower level is completely finished. The interior has been freshly painted throughout and is shown empty, with eleven views virtually staged by the owners and labelled as such; every one can be toggled back to the photograph.

grounds.heading: The grounds
grounds.intro: About an acre of woods on a cul-de-sac, with a screened porch, a deck and a fire pit facing the trees.

house.stagingLine: Rooms marked “virtually staged” have furniture added digitally; walls, floors, windows and the view are untouched.

lowerLevel.heading: Lower-level suite
paragraphs: The finished lower level has its own exterior entrance and a full bath. Its four bedrooms each have an egress window; the plan also shows a recreation room, an exercise room, a workshop and a mudroom.
Altogether the lower level adds 1,491 sq ft of finished space to the 3,814 sq ft above ground.

reels.heading: Lately
reels.intro: Short clips from the house, added while the listing is live. The same clips go out on Instagram and TikTok.
reels._note: Each reel: a 9:16 H.264 MP4 (1080x1920, 15-30 s, muted, captions burned in) under 15 MB in assets/video/reels/, with a JPEG poster of the same name. Newest first; the page shows the newest large and up to six earlier posters. The photographer's fly-through lives under At a glance, not here. Nothing renders until the first item is here and its file exists. Types: sunset (fixed tripod spot on the deck, time-lapse), walk-from-the-door (front door to the pool gate, 4x, real minutes in the caption), room-at-its-hour (10 s static, breakfast room at 7:30, living room at 4 pm).

blacksburg.heading: Life in Blacksburg
paragraphs: Cedarview Drive is in Forest Hills, an established wooded neighbourhood on the south side of Blacksburg, a university town in the New River Valley and home to Virginia Tech and its Corporate Research Center.

The nearest parks and the neighbourhood pool are a walk from the door; the shops on South Main are a short ride; campus, downtown and the library are a few minutes by car or bike. LewisGale Hospital Montgomery is in Blacksburg; Carilion New River Valley Medical Center is in neighbouring Christiansburg.
blacksburg.placesIntro: Times from Google Maps, from the house, measured on a Sunday evening in November 2026.
blacksburg._places: Each place lists the modes that make sense for it: walk for Grissom Lane, bike and drive for South Main and campus, drive only for the hospital, I-81 and the airport. Minutes are Google Maps figures read from the house at an off-peak hour (see `measured`); a TBC minute is simply not shown. `maps` is the destination string for the Directions link, which opens Google Maps with the first listed mode preset so anyone can check the figure.

map._note: Leaflet with OpenStreetMap's standard tiles (CARTO's free basemaps now need an API key): no key, no cookies; the tiles are desaturated in CSS to sit with the palette. Places with offMap: true (the airport) keep their list row but are not pinned, so the map stays on Blacksburg. The theme colours come from design.palette: walk = cobalt, short ride = oak, campus = ridge, farther = rust. A place with fit: false (I-81) is pinned but left out of the opening frame so the map stays on town; its theme chip zooms out to it.
